payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 4. Counting Skip-Atomic Or No-Output Stage2 As Positive Evidence

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL FP8 PTPC Fused MoE on MI308X -- 4. Counting Skip-Atomic Or No-Output Stage2 As Positive Evidence

payload.attempted: Treat a fast stage2 skip-atomic or no-output diagnostic as evidence that stage2 is solved.
payload.lesson: Skip-atomic and no-output timings are diagnostic only. A promotable stage2 path must preserve BF16 output and correctness.

established_fact.mechanism: The real stage2 contract includes BF16 output atomic/read-modify-write traffic. Removing the final output path removes the main unresolved cost.
